bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
DEPLOY=deploy-gaybbs-1
IMG="$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
nodecheck="$(docker run --rm --entrypoint node "$CANDIDATE" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs 2>&1)" || exit 61
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')"
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
LOCAL="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$ACTIVE" = "$LOCAL" || exit 34
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 35
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$ACTIVE" || exit 34
BACKUP=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-search-color-5a93de6
docker tag "$ACTIVE" "$BACKUP"
activated=0
rollback(){
 if [ "$activated" != 1 ]; then
  current="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ "$current" = "$IMG" ] || [ "$current" = "$ACTIVE" ] || [ -z "$current" ]; then
   docker tag "$BACKUP" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
   docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
  fi
 fi
}
trap rollback EXIT
docker tag "$CANDIDATE" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$IMG" || exit 69
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
activated=1
trap - EXIT
